pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft warm electronic piano repeating gentle patterns, ambient pad floating, narrow room reverb, subtle air texture, no vocal)

[Verse 1]
(soft warm electronic piano, deep sub bass rumble, deep low-pitched male vocal)
네가 웃을 때마다 마음이 아려와 My heart aches every time you smile
네 손을 잡으면 If I hold your hand
나처럼 무너질까 두려워 I fear you’ll collapse like me

[Soft Build]
(soft warm electronic piano layers increasing subtly, ambient pad warm glow, deep sub bass soft pulse, deep low-pitched male vocal with cave reverb)
사랑했지만 닿을 수 없던 인연 A connection we loved but couldn’t reach
이제 서로 놓아주자 Now let’s let each other go

[Break]
(soft warm electronic piano only with long reverb tail, narrow room reflections, subtle wind tone, almost no rhythm)

[Verse 2]
(soft warm electronic piano, deep sub bass, ambient pad, deep low-pitched male vocal)
떠나려 하면 붙잡기만 했던 내가 I who only held on when you tried to leave
내가 널 사랑한 만큼 You loved me as much as I loved you

[Emotional Peak]
(soft warm electronic piano with warmer layers, deeper but gentle sub bass, ambient pads expand softly, deep low-pitched male vocal with rich chest resonance and cave reverb)
사랑했지만 서로를 너무 잘 알기에 We loved each other but knew each other too well
가까워질수록 상처만 남는다는 걸 The closer we got, the more it hurt
고마웠어, 그리고 미안해 Thank you, and I’m sorry
내 처음이자 마지막 사랑, 너였어 You were my first and last love

[Outro]
(soft warm electronic piano fading gently, long ambient pad and reverb tails, deep sub bass slowly dissolving, deep low-pitched male vocal echo with long decay)
사랑했어 I loved you
이제는 안녕 Goodbye
잘 가 Take care
(extended reverb and empty space, gradual fade out)
pkg.sunoStyle: Dreamy ambient EDM with deep house influence. Piano: soft warm electronic piano, crystal clear high-end, bright attack, clean transient, front, dry, NOT muffled. Bass: deep sub bass, strong and clearly audible, clean and controlled, stays below vocal. Drums: very minimal, soft slow pulse. VOCAL: male bass voice, very deep low register, heavy chest resonance, dense and thick vocal body, compressed vocal tone, tight low-mid focus, strong and forward presence, voice must feel physically close and heavy, spoken or chant-like delivery, slow controlled phrasing. NO airy, NO breathy, NO thin voice. MIX: vocal dominant and forward, piano clean and bright in front but not overpowering, bass supports depth without masking vocal. SPACE: short tight reverb + deep echo behind only, no washed-out vocal. Atmosphere: dark ambient, night, immersive. Tempo: 65-72 BPM. Restrictions: no distant vocal, no soft vocal, no weak presence. Voice similar to epic cinematic trailer narrator.
